name: Unity
description: Start 2D or 3D games with the Unity editor.

engine.name: Unity
engine.description: A full editor and a large asset store, with C#. Builds for desktop, mobile and consoles.

requires.label: Unity editor
requires.help: Install Unity Hub, then an editor from its Installs page. Wundur uses the editor to make the project.

engine.run: Open the folder in Unity Hub (Add > Add project from disk), then press Play.
